title: architecture-proposal contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-27). The SHAPE of the proposal envelope the `architecture` slot's producer (default faffter-noon-architecture) emits — a best-fit, build-biased architecture proposal generated from the infra profile + brief. Shape is normative here; the proposing STRATEGY (which architecture fits) lives in the producer, not the contract. Fail-loud on a non-object input (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). recommendation is a plain string here: its {build,buy,hybrid} enum is enforced in the compute fn via violations (the spec-review-verdict lens/severity precedent), so an echoed bad value (exit 1) never trips schemaCheck into a spurious fail-loud (exit 2). The proposer GENERATES; FAFF-9's architectural lens CRITIQUES the spec it lands in — no shared logic, they meet only through the spec artifact (ADR-0030).
